output.name: Where-used report/Excel export times out for widely used parts
output.summary: Engineers running a where-used report or Excel export for common parts such as fasteners get a spinning export that times out and fails, blocking ECO work until support runs the report for them.

root_cause.text: Likely the interactive where-used query and export cannot finish within the application timeout for parts used in many assemblies, while the same query run directly against the database succeeds.

quotes.quote: Where-used report times out for fasteners used in many assemblies.
Exporting where-used for 210-007835 to Excel spins and fails.
Ran the report for the user from the database.

evidence.text: Failures cluster on common, heavily reused parts like fasteners, which points to result size rather than specific bad data.

quotes.quote: Where-used report fails for common part
Where-used report times out for fasteners used in many assemblies.

evidence.text: The failure blocks change work because users need where-used lists for ECOs.

quotes.quote: Need the where-used list for an ECO but the export fails.
Need the where-used list for an ECO but the export fails.

evidence.text: Every ticket is resolved by a manual database workaround, so the underlying issue is never fixed and it keeps recurring.

quotes.quote: Ran the report for the user from the database.
Ran the report for the user from the database.

evidence.text: The Excel export path specifically hangs before failing across many part number families.

quotes.quote: Exporting where-used for 450-008010 to Excel spins and fails.
Exporting where-used for 330-007358 to Excel spins and fails.

output.fix: Make where-used export for high-fan-out parts run as an asynchronous/background job against an indexed (or pre-computed) where-used query that delivers the Excel file when complete, instead of a synchronous request bound by the interactive timeout.
